requirements.text: The lamps shall not be capable of being inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: When fitted to the vehicle, the rear lamp's reference axis shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.

requirements.quote: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle and only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos shall be prohibited.
requirements.quote: All logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos are prohibited.

requirements.text: When all other functions with which the rear lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, the photometric and colorimetric requirements of the rear lamp shall be fulfilled.

requirements.text: When a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other functions which can be switched ON together with it, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function or functions and the rear position lamp are switched ON.
requirements.quote: However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics of the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics of any lamp in the rear lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.quote: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4);

requirements.quote: If at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
